one_liner: LinkedIn Ads (Marketing API) is a broad versioned REST API at api.linkedin.com/rest that uses OAuth 2.0 scopes (rw_ads and r_ads). Access goes through the developer portal's API access process, which probably involves approval. The fetched pages show no MCP server.
auth_notes: The pages describe OAuth 2.0 scopes (r_ads, rw_ads) as part of the authentication process, and the docs link to an authorization-code flow page. Composio also lists OAUTH2 as the only scheme. The earlier claim that 2-legged auth is unavailable is not in the fetched pages, so it was dropped.
access_notes: The pages link to a 'Getting API Access' (increasing-access) page but don't include its content. The draft's claims about the Advertising API product and its Development and Standard tiers aren't in the fetched text. They match LinkedIn's known vetted-product model, so app_review is kept at reduced confidence.
blocker_notes: Meaningful use likely requires LinkedIn approval of the app for the Advertising API product. The fetched pages only point to the 'Getting API Access' page and don't state the terms.
